injuries.detail: Landale (hip) is out for Sunday's game against Bucks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
Flemings (back) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bucks.
Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
Gilbert (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Bulls.
Newell (toe) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Chicago.
Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.
Dieng will undergo a procedure to repair a fractured left finger Monday, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.
Rollins (illness) is out for Sunday's game against the Hawks.
